name: Tab Group Sessions
description: tmux-like sessions on top of Chrome Tab Groups, fully keyboard driven.

_execute_action.description: Open the picker (search groups and tabs)

last-group.description: Toggle to the previously focused group

open-picker-window.description: Open the picker in a popup window

next-tab-in-group.description: Next tab in the current group (wraps)

prev-tab-in-group.description: Previous tab in the current group (wraps)

goto-tab-1.description: Go to tab 1 of the current group

goto-tab-2.description: Go to tab 2 of the current group

goto-tab-3.description: Go to tab 3 of the current group

goto-tab-4.description: Go to tab 4 of the current group

goto-tab-5.description: Go to tab 5 of the current group

goto-tab-6.description: Go to tab 6 of the current group

goto-tab-7.description: Go to tab 7 of the current group

goto-tab-8.description: Go to tab 8 of the current group

goto-tab-9.description: Go to the last tab of the current group
